purpose: Untimed bounded diagnostic; no performance claim or path selection by dataset
fixture: existing persisted SCAN image generator; deterministic IDs 1..N; number equals ID and text equals short; default experimental COUNT off
scenarios: public labeled multi-attribute filter plus SUM and COUNT, reopen before query
sorted dense gather of 32 IDs, two columns, 1 group
sorted sparse gather of 3 IDs in distinct groups, two columns
unsorted repeated gather spanning at least two groups, two columns with restored order and multiplicity
old and new snapshots around one property update, querying both and verifying changed and unchanged values
metrics: non-timed scoped existing PerfTrace events: group directory window refills/hits/restarts; group/column/membership/cold decodes; grouped columns; performed/saved owner-route checks; typed run admissions; certified IDs, direct rows; absent event means not recorded, not proven zero
oracle: complete ordered gather values and multiplicity, complete aggregate result and old/new properties; per scenario independently checked
analysis: compare counts per selected owner and distinct group without treating unlike paths as equal; do not add times or infer CPU share; no optimized shortcut without evidence of repeated avoidable work and intact auth/snapshot/budget/cancel/reentry contracts
constraints: bounded 512 nodes, 7 MiB fixture work account, relevant tests only, no external fetch, no change to on-disk format
